name: claudeconnect
notes: Updates reach you faster: the site looks for a new version every minute instead of every half hour, and no longer waits on GitHub's five-minute cache.
No more "Confirm update". When an update finishes, the page switches to the new version by itself, as soon as nothing you were typing or waiting for could be lost.
The Updates panel shows the patch notes for every update: while it installs, when it's done, and for earlier updates. The first time you open a new version it opens on what changed.
The chat list is no longer cut off at 400: it shows up to 3,000 of the chats on your computer.
